changeSet.author: paystack
changeSet.comment: Update v_discount_application_report view to include created_by_username and last_modified_by_username for PostgreSQL
changeSet.sql: DROP VIEW IF EXISTS v_discount_application_report; CREATE VIEW v_discount_application_report AS SELECT da.id, da.discount_rule_id, da.entity_type, da.entity_id, da.charge_id, da.account_number, da.customer_id, da.original_amount, da.discount_amount, da.final_amount, da.application_date, da.transaction_id, da.discount_type, da.fee_type_category, da.triggered_conditions, dr.name AS rule_name, dr.rule_type, c.name AS charge_name, c.charge_time_enum, c.is_penalty, mc.account_no AS customer_account_no, mc.display_name AS customer_name, msa.account_no AS savings_account_no, da.created_by, COALESCE(created_user.username, 'N/A') AS created_by_username, da.created_on_utc, da.last_modified_by, COALESCE(modified_user.username, 'N/A') AS last_modified_by_username, da.last_modified_on_utc FROM m_discount_application da INNER JOIN m_discount_rule dr ON da.discount_rule_id = dr.id INNER JOIN m_charge c ON da.charge_id = c.id LEFT JOIN m_savings_account msa ON da.entity_id = msa.id AND da.entity_type = 'SAVINGS_PRODUCT' LEFT JOIN m_client mc ON (msa.client_id = mc.id OR da.customer_id = mc.id) LEFT JOIN m_appuser created_user ON da.created_by = created_user.id AND created_user.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN m_appuser modified_user ON da.last_modified_by = modified_user.id AND modified_user.is_deleted = false;

changeSet.sql: DROP VIEW IF EXISTS v_discount_application_report; CREATE VIEW v_discount_application_report AS SELECT da.id, da.discount_rule_id, da.entity_type, da.entity_id, da.charge_id, da.account_number, da.customer_id, da.original_amount, da.discount_amount, da.final_amount, da.application_date, da.transaction_id, da.discount_type, da.fee_type_category, da.triggered_conditions, dr.name AS rule_name, dr.rule_type, c.name AS charge_name, c.charge_time_enum, c.is_penalty, mc.account_no AS customer_account_no, mc.display_name AS customer_name, msa.account_no AS savings_account_no, da.created_by, COALESCE(created_user.username, 'N/A') AS created_by_username, da.created_on_utc, da.last_modified_by, COALESCE(modified_user.username, 'N/A') AS last_modified_by_username, da.last_modified_on_utc FROM m_discount_application da INNER JOIN m_discount_rule dr ON da.discount_rule_id = dr.id INNER JOIN m_charge c ON da.charge_id = c.id LEFT JOIN m_savings_account msa ON da.entity_id = msa.id AND da.entity_type = 'SAVINGS_PRODUCT' LEFT JOIN m_client mc ON (msa.client_id = mc.id OR da.customer_id = mc.id) LEFT JOIN m_appuser created_user ON da.created_by = created_user.id AND created_user.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN m_appuser modified_user ON da.last_modified_by = modified_user.id AND modified_user.is_deleted = false;

changeSet.author: paystack
changeSet.comment: Update Discount Audit Trail Report to show usernames instead of user IDs for PostgreSQL

column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT da.id AS "Application ID", COALESCE(mc.account_no, 'N/A') AS "Customer ID", da.account_number AS "Account Number", da.transaction_id AS "Transaction ID", TO_CHAR(da.application_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "Timestamp", da.original_amount AS "Original Fee Amount", da.discount_amount AS "Discounted Fee Amount", da.final_amount AS "Final Fee Amount", da.triggered_conditions AS "Condition(s) Triggered", da.discount_type AS "Discount Type", dr.name AS "Discount Rule Name", dr.rule_type AS "Rule Type", da.charge_name AS "Charge Name", da.fee_type_category AS "Fee Type", COALESCE(da.created_by_username, 'N/A') AS "Created By", CASE WHEN da.created_on_utc IS NULL THEN 'N/A' ELSE TO_CHAR(da.created_on_utc, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') END AS "Created On", COALESCE(da.last_modified_by_username, 'N/A') AS "Last Modified By", CASE WHEN da.last_modified_on_utc IS NULL THEN 'N/A' ELSE TO_CHAR(da.last_modified_on_utc, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') END AS "Last Modified On" FROM v_discount_application_report da LEFT JOIN m_client mc ON da.customer_id = mc.id LEFT JOIN m_discount_rule dr ON da.discount_rule_id = dr.id WHERE da.application_date::date BETWEEN '${startDate}'::date AND '${endDate}'::date AND ('${accountNumber}' = '' OR da.account_number = '${accountNumber}') AND ('${discountType}' = '' OR da.discount_type = '${discountType}') ORDER BY da.application_date DESC

column.value: SELECT da.id AS "Application ID", COALESCE(mc.account_no, 'N/A') AS "Customer ID", da.account_number AS "Account Number", da.transaction_id AS "Transaction ID", DATE_FORMAT(da.application_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS "Timestamp", da.original_amount AS "Original Fee Amount", da.discount_amount AS "Discounted Fee Amount", da.final_amount AS "Final Fee Amount", da.triggered_conditions AS "Condition(s) Triggered", da.discount_type AS "Discount Type", dr.name AS "Discount Rule Name", dr.rule_type AS "Rule Type", da.charge_name AS "Charge Name", da.fee_type_category AS "Fee Type", COALESCE(da.created_by_username, 'N/A') AS "Created By", CASE WHEN da.created_on_utc IS NULL THEN 'N/A' ELSE DATE_FORMAT(da.created_on_utc, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') END AS "Created On", COALESCE(da.last_modified_by_username, 'N/A') AS "Last Modified By", CASE WHEN da.last_modified_on_utc IS NULL THEN 'N/A' ELSE DATE_FORMAT(da.last_modified_on_utc, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') END AS "Last Modified On" FROM v_discount_application_report da LEFT JOIN m_client mc ON da.customer_id = mc.id LEFT JOIN m_discount_rule dr ON da.discount_rule_id = dr.id WHERE DATE(da.application_date) BETWEEN DATE('${startDate}') AND DATE('${endDate}') AND ('${accountNumber}' = '' OR da.account_number = '${accountNumber}') AND ('${discountType}' = '' OR da.discount_type = '${discountType}') ORDER BY da.application_date DESC
